{"edit_description":"Create a NEW single self-contained HTML file implementing an animated neon "neuron growth" simulation. Use ONLY HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript, and dat.gui (via CDN script tag https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js). No other external libraries, frameworks, modules, images, or assets. Everything inline in this one file. Do NOT mention any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted visual style anywhere in code or comments.

PAGE / LAYOUT:
- Dark page background #05070f. One 800x800 <canvas id="scene" width="800" height="800"> perfectly centered on the page (flexbox centering, margin 0, overflow hidden).
- Canvas has a subtle outer glow via CSS box-shadow using #101a3a, and a thin 1px border rgba(0,229,255,0.25).
- Small unobtrusive caption/title text under or over the canvas in #ffd400, monospace font, low opacity.

EXACT NEON PALETTE (use these as the default parameter values):
- background: #05070f
- background glow: #101a3a
- main branch color: #00e5ff
- secondary/accent branch color: #d6ff00
- synapse color: #ff2bd6
- pulse color: #fff36a
- UI accent: #ffd400
- optional grid/scanline: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08)

SIMULATION (vanilla JS, lightweight arrays/objects only):
- Seed neurons: on (re)generation create a random integer 3..6 seed neurons positioned near the canvas center (random offset within ~120px of center). Each seed has a position and a small glowing soma (circle).
- Branch growth: each seed recursively grows branching axon/dendrite lines. Represent each branch as an object {points: [], angle, depth, thickness, done, color} that extends step-by-step (a few pixels per frame controlled by "branch growth speed"), so growth is visibly animated, NOT instant. Each step appends a new point; the angle wanders randomly each step scaled by "branch curvature" for smooth organic curves. A branch stops when it reaches "max branch length" (number of segments) or leaves the canvas bounds (with margin).
- Splitting: while a branch grows, at each new segment there is a "branch split chance" probability to spawn a child side branch (smaller thickness, depth+1, angle deflected by a random amount). Recursion limited by "max branch depth" and a global total branch cap (e.g. 400) for performance. Child branches of depth >= 2 use the accent branch color with some probability (e.g. 35%) else main branch color. Randomly vary branch thickness slightly (base ~2.2px * 0.75^depth with +/-25% jitter).
- Rendering branches: draw each branch as a smooth path through its points using quadraticCurveTo (midpoint smoothing technique), thin neon strokes with ctx.shadowBlur glow (shadowColor = branch color).
- Growth ends naturally when all branches are done (stable size); keep animating afterwards.

SYNAPSE DETECTION:
- Each frame (or every few frames), check the current growing tip points of branches against other branch tips (and recently finished tips): when two tips from DIFFERENT branches come within "synapse distance threshold" pixels, create a synapse object {a, b, x, y, phase} at the midpoint. Prevent duplicates: keep a Set of "idA:idB" branch-id pairs already connected, and skip if the pair exists or if an existing synapse is within ~12px. Cap total synapses (e.g. 120).
- Synapses glow softly and pulse over time: radius/alpha oscillate via sin(time*speed + phase), brightness scaled by "synapse glow strength". Draw as a small filled circle with shadowBlur in synapse color, brighter than branches.

PULSES:
- Maintain an array of pulses. Spawn randomly over time at a rate controlled by "pulse frequency" (probability per frame), each pulse picks a random existing synapse and travels from neuron A tip to neuron B tip (or reverse). Position computed by linear interpolation t from 0..1 advanced by "pulse speed" each frame; optionally add a tiny perpendicular jitter for an electric-spark look. Draw as a bright small circle/short streak in pulse color with strong shadowBlur, alpha scaled by "pulse brightness". Remove when t >= 1. Cap active pulses (e.g. 60). After growth finishes, pulses keep firing continuously so the scene stays alive; also randomly re-activate different paths.

VISUAL EFFECTS:
- Background: fill with background color each frame; add a soft radial "background glow" #101a3a gradient centered behind the network (pre-rendered once to an offscreen canvas for performance, redrawn each frame with drawImage).
- Faint vignette around canvas edges: pre-rendered radial gradient (transparent center -> dark edges) drawn each frame.
- Optional lightweight scanlines: pre-rendered offscreen pattern of horizontal 1px lines rgba(0,229,255,0.08) every 4px, drawn with low alpha; may scroll slowly.
- Subtle animated background noise/grit: a few (e.g. 40) tiny faint dots drifting or flickering randomly, very cheap.
- Use ctx.shadowBlur for all neon bloom (branches ~8, synapses ~16, pulses ~18). Reset shadowBlur=0 when drawing background/scanlines/vignette. Use globalCompositeOperation 'lighter' for pulses/synapses if it stays cheap, else normal.

GUI (dat.gui), folders exactly: "Growth", "Synapses", "Pulses", "Visuals".
- Growth folder: neuron count (1..10 step 1, default random 3..6 i.e. default 4), branch growth speed (0.5..10, default 3), max branch depth (1..8 step 1, default 5), branch split chance (0..0.3, default 0.08), branch curvature (0..0.6, default 0.18), max branch length (20..200 step 1, default 90). Changing growth params (except speed) triggers regenerate.
- Synapses folder: synapse distance threshold (5..60, default 22), synapse glow strength (0..2, default 1).
- Pulses folder: pulse speed (0.001..0.05, default 0.012), pulse frequency (0..0.2, default 0.04), pulse brightness (0..2, default 1).
- Visuals folder: color pickers — background color (#05070f), branch color (#00e5ff), accent branch color (#d6ff00), synapse color (#ff2bd6), pulse color (#fff36a); plus a checkbox "scanlines" default true.
- Top-level buttons (not in folders, or in a small "Actions" area): "regenerate network", "clear canvas" (clears all branches/synapses/pulses and the canvas, leaving seeds removed too — a blank slate that stays empty until regenerate), "pause / resume" (toggles a paused flag; when paused, requestAnimationFrame loop still runs but skips updates and redraws, or simply stops advancing simulation time).

CODE STRUCTURE: keep simple and compact, single <script> at end of body, clearly separated sections with short comments: // ===== Setup =====, // ===== GUI setup =====, // ===== Neuron growth =====, // ===== Synapse detection =====, // ===== Pulse animation =====, // ===== Rendering =====, plus a main loop using requestAnimationFrame with delta-time-aware but simple logic. All state in a small `state`/`params` object and plain arrays (neurons, branches, synapses, pulses). No classes needed; plain functions and objects. Ensure no runtime errors, no undefined variables, dat.gui color controls use addColor. The file must work when opened directly in a browser (file://) with internet access for the dat.gui CDN.","path":"neuron_growth_openrouter-moonshotai-kimi-k3_01.html"}
